description: List the brand's reply drafts, oldest first. Free, read-only. status filter: one of queued | filled | posted | removed | stale | done | failed | cancelled, or an array of them. Omit for all. limit 1-100 (default 50). queued = waiting for the extension; filled = text is in the box, waiting for the user to post; posted = the extension found it live on Reddit; removed = mods removed it or it is hidden from the public; stale = filled over 72h ago and never found live (re-queue it); done = user marked it posted (Quora / manual); failed = see `error`; cancelled.

status.description: Status or list of statuses to include.

name: reply_drafts_list
